# Sample Incomplete Project — Test Fixture Only

This is a synthetic, intentionally incomplete project instance used exclusively
as a test fixture for gate.py / validate_project.py behavior on incomplete
projects. It is NOT an official CUMCM problem and must not be used as one.

## Problem (synthetic placeholder)

A small workshop produces two products with limited resources. Determine the
optimal production mix. This placeholder exists only to give the fixture a
non-empty inputs/ directory.

Sub-questions:
1. Formulate the optimization model.
2. Solve and validate.
